description: Toolbar de roster con boton de vista simplificada seleccionado y tooltip centrado
pre_capture_js: (() => { const buttons = [...document.querySelectorAll('button[gsbuttontoggle]')]; const small = buttons.find((button) => button.querySelector('gs-icon[aria-label="density_small"]')); const large = buttons.find((button) => button.querySelector('gs-icon[aria-label="density_large"]')); if (small) small.classList.add('gs-button-toggle--active'); if (large) large.classList.remove('gs-button-toggle--active'); const tip = document.querySelector('gs-tooltip'); if (tip && small) { const rect = small.getBoundingClientRect(); const pane = tip.closest('.cdk-overlay-pane'); const box = tip.closest('.cdk-overlay-connected-position-bounding-box') || pane; if (pane) { pane.style.position = 'fixed'; pane.style.left = `${Math.round(rect.left + rect.width / 2)}px`; pane.style.top = `${Math.round(rect.bottom + 6)}px`; pane.style.transform = 'translateX(-50%)'; pane.style.zIndex = '9999'; } if (box && box !== pane) { box.style.position = 'fixed'; box.style.left = '0px'; box.style.top = '0px'; box.style.width = '100vw'; box.style.height = '100vh'; box.style.pointerEvents = 'none'; } } })();
